query:
-- Find Sharron's Slot 11 meeting
SELECT m.id, m.sponsorId, m.attendeeId, m.timeSlot, m.attendeeNumber, s.name as sponsorName
FROM meetings m
JOIN sponsors s ON s.id = m.sponsorId
WHERE m.attendeeId = '9319401' AND m.timeSlot = 11;

-- Check Rikki's booked slots and total meetings
SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(m.timeSlot ORDER BY m.timeSlot) as bookedSlots, COUNT(*) as totalMeetings
FROM meetings m
WHERE m.attendeeId = '17812226737' AND m.status IN ('confirmed','suggested');

-- Check which sponsors Rikki has already met
SELECT m.sponsorId, s.name as sponsorName
FROM meetings m
JOIN sponsors s ON s.id = m.sponsorId
WHERE m.attendeeId = '17812226737'
GROUP BY m.sponsorId, s.name;
